stem: The recycling scheme, ____ by the city council in 2019, has reduced landfill waste by almost a third.
explain_zh: 空格是非限定關係子句的縮減形式，主詞 scheme 是被動地「被推行」，所以要用過去分詞 introduced 表示被動意義。introducing 是主動語態，方案本身不會去「推行」；having introduced 語態錯誤（暗示方案自己完成了推行的動作）；introduce 是原形動詞，不能單獨放在名詞後面。這類縮減關係子句寫對能展現雅思 GRA 的句構多樣性。

stem: The council adopted a new rota system ____ residents can book recycling collection slots online instead of waiting for a fixed weekly pickup.
explain_zh: whereby 意思是「藉由此（系統）」，等於 by which，專門用來描述一個「制度、系統」如何運作，是雅思寫作描述政策機制的高分字。which 若要表達同樣意思必須寫成 by which 才完整；whom 只能指人；what 不能當關係代名詞接在名詞 system 後面。誤用 which 而漏掉介系詞是很常見的扣分點。

stem: ____ nearly half of first-year students drop out within twelve months has prompted the university to redesign its orientation programme.
explain_zh: The fact that + 完整子句可以當作句子的主詞，是雅思寫作把因果關係濃縮成一個名詞子句主詞的常見高分句型。What 用法不合語意（不是「所做的事」）；Which 不能無先行詞當主詞使用；Because 是從屬連接詞，不能直接當句子主詞。整句主詞是「這個事實」，動詞用單數 has prompted 也呼應。

stem: Companies ____ profits fell sharply during the pandemic have been slower to invest in staff training this year.
explain_zh: 空格後面直接接名詞 profits，表示「公司的利潤」，這種所有格關係要用 whose。which／that 是一般關係代名詞，不能直接接名詞表示所有；who 用於指人，且同樣不能表示所有格。whose 正確使用能讓一句話同時交代主詞與其所屬資訊，減少另外造句。

stem: Traffic congestion in the capital has become ____ severe that the government is now considering a congestion charge for private vehicles.
explain_zh: so + 形容詞 + that 子句是固定句型，表示「如此…以致於」，這裡 severe 是形容詞，所以要用 so。such 後面須直接接名詞（such severe congestion that），不能單獨接形容詞；too 不與 that 子句連用（too...to 才對）；very 不能接 that 子句。這個句型是雅思寫作表達因果強度的常見結構。

stem: The museum attracted ____ a large number of visitors in its opening month that extra staff had to be hired at short notice.
explain_zh: such + a + 形容詞 + 名詞 + that 是固定句型，這裡 a large number of visitors 是名詞片語，所以要用 such。so 若要用這個語意必須改變語序（so large a number of visitors that），與題幹不符；too 不能接 that 子句；very 不能接 that 子句。學生常混淆 so 與 such 的搭配對象，此題專門練習這個分辨點。

stem: Not until the final week of the course ____ students realise how much reading was still required for the exam.
explain_zh: Not until 放在句首會觸發倒裝，後面要用助動詞加主詞，且整句敘述的是過去已完成的課程，故用過去式 did。do 時態不對；have 需要完成式語境但句中沒有過去分詞搭配；will 是未來式，與後面 realise 的過去語境矛盾。這種倒裝句型能展現高階句構掌握度。

stem: ____ the current growth rate continues, the city's population is expected to double within the next twenty-five years.
explain_zh: Given that 後面可以直接接完整子句，意思是「假設／考量到…」，符合此處「若成長率持續」的條件語意。Despite 與 Because of 後面只能接名詞或動名詞，不能直接接完整子句；Even 單獨使用語意不完整，需搭配 if 或 though。Given that 是雅思寫作常見的條件式連接詞。

stem: ____ for government subsidies, many small farms in the region would have closed down during the drought.
explain_zh: Were it not for 是 if it were not for 的倒裝虛擬語氣，用來假設「若不是因為…」，後面接 would have + 過去分詞表示與過去事實相反的假設。If it was not for 動詞式錯誤（虛擬語氣須用 were 不是 was）；Unless it is not for 是雙重否定的錯誤結構；Without it were 文法不通。這是雅思寫作展現高階假設句型的關鍵結構。

stem: Students ____ part-time jobs while studying often report higher stress levels than those who do not work.
explain_zh: 空格是縮減關係子句 who hold 的分詞形式，因為學生是主動「持有」工作，要用現在分詞 holding。held 是過去分詞，語態錯誤（學生不是被工作「持有」）；hold 是原形動詞，不能直接接在名詞後面當修飾語；to hold 表示目的而非正在進行的狀態，語意不符。

stem: One key reason ____ university applications have fallen this year is the rising cost of accommodation in major cities.
explain_zh: reason 後面接原因子句時，關係副詞要用 why，等於 reason for which。which 若要用需改成 for which 才完整；what 不能接在名詞 reason 後面；who 只能指人。why 是描述原因時最自然、最正確的選擇。

stem: Average commuting times in the city have risen by nearly twenty minutes, ____ has led many companies to allow remote working.
explain_zh: 逗號後面的非限定關係子句只能用 which 來指前面整句話的內容，不能用 that。it 會造成兩個獨立子句用逗號連接的「逗號拼接」錯誤；what 不是關係代名詞，不能這樣接在完整句子後面。which 是雅思寫作補充說明整體情況時的高分結構。

stem: By the time the new airport terminal opens next year, construction costs ____ risen by almost forty percent above the original budget.
explain_zh: by the time + 未來時間子句搭配未來完成式 will have + 過去分詞，表示「到某個未來時間點之前已經完成」。have 是現在完成式，時態不符未來語境；had 是過去完成式，適用於過去而非未來；would 後面沒有接 have 則不完整。這是雅思寫作預測趨勢常用的時態結構。

stem: ____ facing strong opposition from local residents, the developer proceeded with the construction of the new shopping centre.
explain_zh: In spite of 後面直接接動名詞 facing，語意是「儘管面對…」。Despite of 是常見錯誤，despite 本身已含介系詞意義，絕對不能再加 of；Although 是連接詞，後面必須接完整子句而非動名詞；Because of 語意錯誤（此處要表達讓步而非原因）。分清 despite／in spite of／although 的用法是雅思文法常見扣分點。

stem: A significant ____ in air pollution levels was recorded in the city centre after the low-emission zone was introduced.
explain_zh: 空格前面有冠詞 a 與形容詞 significant，後面接 in，需要一個名詞，動詞 reduce 名詞化後是 reduction。reduce 是動詞不能接在冠詞後面；reducing 是動名詞，通常不需要冠詞 a 直接修飾；reductive 是形容詞。把動詞改寫成名詞是雅思寫作提升正式度、避免重複用動詞的重要技巧。

stem: The rapid ____ of e-commerce has forced many small high-street shops to close over the past five years.
explain_zh: 形容詞 rapid 修飾名詞，動詞 expand 的名詞形式是 expansion。expand 是動詞形式錯誤；expanding 是動名詞，較少直接被形容詞 rapid 修飾且後面接 of 不自然；expandable 是形容詞（可擴展的），語意不符。名詞化句型能讓雅思寫作的主詞更精簡有力。

stem: An independent ____ of the flood defences concluded that several coastal towns remain at serious risk.
explain_zh: 形容詞 independent 修飾的必須是名詞，動詞 assess 的名詞形式是 assessment。assess 是動詞，assessing 是動名詞（此處語境不需要）；assessive 不是英文常用字。用 assessment 當主詞能讓整句更符合學術報告的客觀語氣。

stem: Voter ____ in local elections has fallen to its lowest level in three decades, according to the latest figures.
explain_zh: Voter 修飾後面的名詞，動詞 participate 的名詞形式是 participation，作整句主詞。participate 是動詞不能直接當主詞；participating 是動名詞，此處語意不自然；participatory 是形容詞（參與式的）。名詞化後動詞用單數 has fallen 也一致。

stem: Household energy ____ typically rises during the winter months as families use more heating and lighting.
explain_zh: 空格前面是名詞 energy，需要另一個名詞與其組成複合名詞，consume 的名詞形式是 consumption，且與單數動詞 rises 一致。consuming 是動名詞／分詞，語意不順；consumable 是形容詞（可消耗的）；consume 是動詞。consumption 是雅思 Task 1 描述能源、資源數據時的核心字彙。

stem: Large-scale rural-to-urban ____ over the past two decades has placed enormous pressure on housing in major cities.
explain_zh: 形容詞片語 rural-to-urban 修飾名詞，動詞 migrate 的名詞形式是 migration，作句子主詞並搭配單數動詞 has placed。migrate 是動詞；migrating 是動名詞，此處不自然；migratory 是形容詞（遷徙性的，如候鳥）。migration 是描述人口趨勢的關鍵名詞化用字。

stem: The ____ of routine factory tasks has reduced the number of low-skilled manufacturing jobs available to young workers.
explain_zh: 定冠詞 The 後面加 of 片語需要名詞，動詞 automate 的名詞形式是 automation。automate 是動詞；automating 是動名詞，此處搭配定冠詞 the 不自然；automatic 是形容詞（自動的）。automation 是雅思科技類作文常見的名詞化主詞。

stem: Strict ____ on single-use plastics were introduced last year in an effort to cut down on ocean waste.
explain_zh: 形容詞 strict 修飾名詞，且後面動詞 were 是複數，動詞 restrict 的名詞複數形式 restrictions 最符合文法。restrict 是動詞；restricting 是動名詞，不會用複數動詞 were 搭配；restrictive 是形容詞（限制性的）。restrictions 作主詞時要注意單複數與動詞一致。

stem: Coastal ____ to rising sea levels will require significant investment in flood barriers over the coming decades.
explain_zh: 形容詞 Coastal 修飾名詞，動詞 adapt 的名詞形式是 adaptation，後面接 to 表示「對…的調適」。adapt 是動詞；adaptive 是形容詞（適應性的）；adapting 是動名詞，此處語意不自然。adaptation 是氣候變遷主題作文的核心名詞化字彙。

stem: Small businesses make a substantial ____ to local employment, even though they rarely attract as much media attention as large firms.
explain_zh: 動詞片語 make a + 形容詞 + 名詞 是固定結構，動詞 contribute 的名詞形式是 contribution。contribute 是動詞不能接在冠詞 a 後面；contributing 是動名詞；contributory 是形容詞（有貢獻的）。make a contribution to 是雅思寫作常見的高分固定搭配。

stem: Economic ____ following the recession was slower in rural areas than in the capital, where investment returned much more quickly.
explain_zh: 形容詞 Economic 修飾的必須是名詞，動詞 recover 的名詞形式是 recovery，並搭配單數動詞 was。recover 是動詞；recovering 是動名詞，此處不自然；recoverable 是形容詞（可恢復的）。recovery 是描述景氣趨勢的關鍵名詞。

stem: Continuous ____ in battery technology has made electric vehicles considerably more affordable over the last ten years.
explain_zh: 形容詞 Continuous 修飾名詞並搭配單數動詞 has made，動詞 innovate 的名詞形式是 innovation。innovate 是動詞；innovative 是形容詞（創新的）；innovating 是動名詞，此處語意不自然。innovation 是科技類作文常用的名詞化主詞。

stem: A steady ____ in air quality has been observed in cities that rely heavily on coal-fired power stations.
explain_zh: 冠詞 A 加形容詞 steady 後面需要名詞，動詞 deteriorate 的名詞形式是 deterioration。deteriorate 是動詞；deteriorating 是動名詞，此處語意不自然；deteriorated 是過去分詞（形容詞用法），不能被冠詞直接修飾當主詞核心。deterioration 常用於描述環境惡化的趨勢句。

stem: Farmers in the region have pursued crop ____ as a strategy to reduce their dependence on a single harvest.
explain_zh: 名詞 crop 前後組成複合名詞，動詞 diversify 的名詞形式是 diversification。diversify 是動詞；diversifying 是動名詞，此處搭配 pursued 受詞應為名詞；diverse 是形容詞（多樣的）。diversification 是農業與經濟主題常見的名詞化字彙。

stem: The introduction of congestion charging is ____ the single most effective policy for reducing traffic in city centres.
explain_zh: 空格修飾後面的最高級名詞片語 the single most effective policy，要用副詞 arguably，意思是「可以說是」，是雅思寫作提出強烈主張但保留空間的限制語。argue 是動詞；arguable 是形容詞，不能直接修飾名詞片語當副詞用；argument 是名詞。arguably 能避免把個人意見寫成絕對事實。

stem: Students who attend smaller seminar groups ____ perform better in oral assessments than those in large lecture classes.
explain_zh: 主詞 Students 是複數，tend to 是描述普遍傾向、留有例外空間的限制語動詞片語，須用原形 tend。tends to 是第三人稱單數形式，與複數主詞不一致；tending to 不是限定動詞，句子會缺少主要動詞；tended 是過去式，與現在普遍現象的語境不符。tend to 是雅思寫作最常見的軟化語氣詞。

stem: ____ likely that demand for renewable energy will continue to rise as fossil fuel prices become less predictable.
explain_zh: It is likely that 是描述可能性的固定限制語句型，用虛主詞 It 代替後面的 that 子句。There is likely 需改成 there is likely to be 才完整；This is／That is 不能直接接 likely that 這種結構。It is likely that 是雅思寫作預測趨勢時最安全的保守用語。

stem: The decline in newspaper sales can, ____ , be explained by the rise of free online news sources.
explain_zh: to some extent 是固定片語，意思是「在某種程度上」，用來限縮論述的絕對性。to some extend 把名詞 extent 誤拼成動詞 extend；in some extent 與 by some extent 介系詞搭配錯誤，正確搭配只能是 to some extent。這個片語能避免把單一原因寫得太武斷。

stem: Regular physical exercise ____ widely believed to improve concentration and academic performance among teenagers.
explain_zh: is widely believed to 是被動限制語句型，主詞 exercise 是不可數單數名詞，須搭配單數動詞 is。are 與複數不符；be 不能單獨當主要動詞使用；being 是分詞，不能作為句子唯一的主要動詞。is widely believed to 能把個人看法包裝成有共識支持但非絕對的說法。

stem: It ____ be argued that standardised testing fails to capture creativity and critical thinking skills in young learners.
explain_zh: could be argued that 是雅思寫作最經典的限制語句型，表示「可以主張、但不是唯一定論」。would have 後面須接過去分詞而非 be argued，時態結構不合；shall 語域過於正式且不表達限制語氣；must 語氣過於武斷、不是保留空間的用法。could 能讓論點顯得客觀而非武斷。

stem: The new marking scheme ____ to have improved consistency between examiners, although further data is still needed.
explain_zh: 主詞 scheme 是單數，appear to 是限制語動詞片語，須用第三人稱單數 appears，且與後文 although further data is still needed 的現在時語境一致。appear 動詞不一致；appearing 不是限定動詞；appeared 是過去式，與現在仍持續評估的語境不符。appears to 能表達「看似如此，但尚未完全確定」。

stem: Whether the new policy will reduce hospital waiting times ____ by no means certain at this stage.
explain_zh: Whether 引導的名詞子句當主詞時視為單數，須搭配單數動詞 is；by no means certain 意思是「絕非確定」，是承認不確定性的限制語。are 與單數子句主詞不符；be 不能單獨當主要動詞；being 是分詞。is by no means certain 能誠實表達論點的侷限性。

stem: ____ is some evidence that shorter working weeks can increase, rather than reduce, overall productivity.
explain_zh: There is some evidence that 是固定的存在句限制語結構，表示「有部分（但非全部）證據顯示」。It／This／That is some evidence that 都不符合英文固定用法，這三個代名詞不能這樣接續 some evidence that。There is some evidence that 讓論點顯得有依據但不誇大。

stem: If current trends continue, the city ____ well face serious water shortages within the next decade.
explain_zh: may well 是固定的限制語搭配，意思是「很有可能」，語氣比 can 或 must 更謹慎中立。can well 不是慣用搭配；shall 過於正式且不表可能性；must 語氣太肯定，等於斷言一定會發生。may well 適合用在雅思寫作預測未來但保留不確定性時。

stem: It ____ unclear whether the benefits of the new curriculum will outweigh the costs of retraining teachers.
explain_zh: 虛主詞 It 是第三人稱單數，remain unclear whether 是限制語結構，須用單數動詞 remains，且與句子整體現在式語境一致。remain 動詞不一致；remained 是過去式，與現階段仍不確定的語境不符；remaining 不是限定動詞。remains unclear whether 誠實承認論點尚無定論。

stem: It is generally ____ that early exposure to a second language benefits long-term cognitive development.
explain_zh: It is generally accepted that 是被動限制語固定句型，空格須用過去分詞 accepted 搭配 be 動詞形成被動語態。accept 是原形動詞；accepting 是分詞但語態錯誤（不是「正在接受」）；accepts 是主動第三人稱單數，不能直接跟在 is 後面。accepted 表示「普遍認同但非絕對真理」。

stem: The available evidence ____ to suggest that online courses suit independent learners better than classroom-based ones.
explain_zh: 主詞 evidence 是不可數單數名詞，seem to 是限制語動詞片語，須用第三人稱單數 seems。seem 與單數主詞不一致；seeming 不是限定動詞，句子會缺少主要動詞；have seemed 的助動詞 have 用於複數主詞，與單數 evidence 不符。seems to suggest 讓推論顯得謹慎而非絕對。

stem: The sharp rise in coastal erosion ____ thought to be linked to increased storm frequency in recent years.
explain_zh: 主詞是單數名詞片語 the sharp rise，is thought to be linked to 是被動限制語結構，須用單數動詞 is。are 與單數主詞不一致；be 不能單獨當主要動詞；being 是分詞。is thought to 表示「被認為」而非確定事實，語氣比直接斷言更保守。

stem: Many universities now offer online degree programmes. ____ has made higher education more accessible to working adults.
explain_zh: This 可以用單數指代整句話（提供線上學位課程這件事），是雅思寫作承接前一句概念最常見的方式。It 通常需要明確的單數名詞先行詞，指代整個概念時不夠清楚；They 與 These 都是複數，但前一句的概念是單一現象，不能用複數代詞承接。This 是連貫段落意義的關鍵銜接詞。

stem: The report highlights problems like traffic congestion, air pollution and noise. ____ issues are increasingly common in fast-growing cities.
explain_zh: such + 複數名詞 用來統稱前面列出的整類問題，意思是「這類問題」。This／That 是單數指示詞，不能修飾複數名詞 issues；Much 只能修飾不可數名詞，issues 是可數複數名詞，用法錯誤。such issues 是雅思寫作歸納前述例子最自然的銜接方式。

stem: Some commuters choose to cycle to work despite the rain, while others refuse to ____ under any circumstances.
explain_zh: do so 是取代前面提到的動作（cycle to work）最正式的替代用法，且要接在 refuse to 之後用原形動詞。does so 主詞 others 是複數，動詞應用原形 do 而非第三人稱單數 does；make so 不是英文的固定搭配；doing so 是動名詞，不能接在 refuse to 這個「to + 原形」的結構後面。do so 避免重複前文動詞片語。

stem: The survey compared attitudes in rural and urban areas; ____ showed far greater concern about public transport provision.
explain_zh: the latter 指前面提到的兩者中「後者」（urban areas），是雅思寫作比較兩項事物時常用的銜接詞。the later 把 latter（後者）誤拼成 later（較晚的），詞性與拼字都錯；the lastly 與 the end one 都不是英文中指代「後者」的固定用法。分清 latter／later 是常見拼字混淆點。

stem: Rates of childhood obesity have risen sharply in the United States. ____ , figures in several European countries have also increased in recent years.
explain_zh: Similarly 用來連接兩個方向一致（都在上升）的資訊，語意銜接正確。However 表示轉折對比，但後句其實是支持前句而非反駁；Although 是從屬連接詞，不能直接加逗號接完整句子開頭當獨立句的連接副詞；Despite 後面須接名詞或動名詞，不能接逗號加完整子句。選對連接副詞才能正確傳達句間邏輯關係。

stem: Fuel prices rose sharply throughout the year. ____ , many households reduced their spending on non-essential travel.
explain_zh: As a result 表示因果關係，正確連接「油價上漲」這個原因與「家庭減少非必要旅遊支出」這個結果。Moreover 與 In addition 是附加語意，並非因果；Nevertheless 表示讓步轉折，與此處順向的因果邏輯不符。選對因果銜接詞是雅思寫作邏輯連貫的關鍵。

stem: The proposal offers ____ a clear timetable nor sufficient detail about funding, which has frustrated local residents.
explain_zh: neither…nor 是固定的相關連接詞組合，前後兩個否定項目要用 neither 搭配 nor。either 必須搭配 or 而非 nor；not…nor 不是標準搭配，正式寫作應用 neither…nor；no 無法與 nor 搭配使用。neither…nor 是雅思寫作並列否定兩件事時最正式的結構。

stem: The new curriculum aims to develop ____ independent thinking and practical problem-solving skills among secondary students.
explain_zh: both…and 是固定的相關連接詞組合，用來並列兩項並重的目標。either 必須搭配 or；neither 必須搭配 nor 且語意會變成否定，與此處正向目標矛盾；whether 用於表達選擇或不確定，不能與 and 搭配。both…and 讓兩個目標在文法上完全對等。

stem: Male and female graduates reported average starting salaries of £24,000 and £22,500 ____ , revealing a persistent pay gap.
explain_zh: respectively 是副詞，用來說明前面兩組數字分別對應前面提到的兩個項目（男性、女性），是雅思 Task 1 描述配對數據的常見銜接詞。respective 是形容詞，不能單獨放在句尾當副詞使用；respectfully 意思是「恭敬地」，與語意無關；respected 意思是「受敬重的」，也是語意混淆詞。

stem: Effective revision involves organising notes clearly, testing recall regularly and ____ realistic weekly goals.
explain_zh: 此句用 involves + 動名詞列舉三個平行項目：organising、testing、setting，文法上必須保持形式一致，故用 setting。to set 破壞了動名詞的平行結構；sets 是動詞第三人稱單數，不能接在 involves 的受詞位置；set 是原形動詞，同樣不符合動名詞平行結構。平行結構是雅思寫作 GRA 評分中容易被扣分的細節。

stem: The council identified a serious shortage of affordable land as the main obstacle; ____ , the scheme's future now looks uncertain.
explain_zh: consequently 表示因果關係，正確連接「土地短缺是主要障礙」與「計畫前景不確定」這個結果。for instance 用於舉例，語意不符；in other words 用於換句話說，並非因果；on the contrary 表示相反，與此處順向邏輯矛盾。選對銜接副詞能讓論述的因果鏈清楚呈現。

stem: Many economists predict a slowdown next year, and government advisers now appear to believe ____ too.
explain_zh: believe so 是取代前面整個子句（there will be a slowdown）最正式的替代用法，避免重複整句內容。believe it 需要明確的單一名詞先行詞，指代整個看法時不夠精確；believe that 後面須接完整子句而非單獨使用；believe this 語意上較適合引出新資訊而非替代前述內容。do so／believe so 是雅思寫作常用的替代銜接手法。

stem: The survey identified three barriers to healthy eating, the most significant of ____ being the high cost of fresh produce.
explain_zh: the most significant of which being 是非限定關係子句的縮減形式，關係代名詞 which 指代前面的 three barriers，同一子句內只能用關係代名詞承接。it 是人稱代名詞，不能在同一子句中扮演連接角色；those 是指示代名詞，同樣不能當關係代名詞使用；them 是受格人稱代名詞，用在此處會造成句子結構斷裂。which 讓兩個子句合併得更精簡。

stem: Demand for electric cars has grown steadily in Europe, and ____ true of several markets in Asia.
explain_zh: the same is true of 是固定的銜接片語，用來說明另一件事情同樣成立，前面須加定冠詞 the。same is 漏掉了必要的冠詞 the；it is the same true of 在 the same 後面又多接 true of 造成結構重複錯誤；so is the same 是不合文法的混合結構。the same is true of 是雅思寫作連結兩個相似現象的高分句型。

stem: Having finished the experiment, the data was analysed carefully by the research team. Which is the correct version of the sentence?
options: Having finished the experiment, the research team analysed the data carefully.
Having finished the experiment, the data was carefully analysing by the research team.
Having finished the experiment, the data was analysed carefully by the research team.
Finishing the experiment, the data was analysed carefully, by the research team.
explain_zh: 分詞構句 Having finished the experiment 的邏輯主詞必須是句子的主詞，完成實驗的是研究團隊而非數據，所以主詞要換成 the research team，這是修正「垂懸分詞」的正確寫法。選項二把動詞誤寫成主動進行式 analysing，語態錯誤；選項三與原句相同，主詞仍是錯誤的 data；選項四同樣沒有修正垂懸分詞問題。垂懸修飾語是雅思寫作最常見的文法扣分點之一。

stem: The results were surprising, the team decided to repeat the experiment to confirm them. Which is the correct version of the sentence?
options: The results were surprising, the team decided to repeat the experiment to confirm them.
The results were surprising, so the team decided to repeat the experiment to confirm them.
The results were surprising the team decided to repeat the experiment to confirm them.
The results were surprising, therefore the team decided to repeat the experiment to confirm them.
explain_zh: 原句是兩個獨立子句只用逗號連接，屬於「逗號拼接」錯誤，加上對等連接詞 so 就能正確銜接因果關係。選項一維持逗號拼接的錯誤；選項三完全沒有標點，變成更嚴重的連寫句；選項四的 therefore 是連接副詞，同樣不能只靠逗號連接兩個獨立子句，須用分號或句號。逗號拼接是雅思寫作扣分的常見結構錯誤。

stem: The number of students applying to study abroad have increased significantly over the past decade. Which is the correct version of the sentence?
options: The number of students applying to study abroad have increased significantly over the past decade.
The number of students applying to study abroad are increasing significantly over the past decade.
The number of students applying to study abroad has increased significantly over the past decade.
A number of students applying to study abroad has increased significantly over the past decade.
explain_zh: the number of 是單數主詞，動詞須用單數 has increased，這是雅思寫作常見的主詞動詞一致錯誤。選項一與選項二都誤用複數動詞 have／are；選項四把 the number of（數量）誤改成 a number of（許多），語意整個改變，且 a number of 本身應搭配複數動詞才對，這裡卻用了單數 has，前後矛盾。分清 the number of 與 a number of 是常見易錯點。

stem: The report recommends reducing waste, to improve recycling rates and investing in public transport. Which is the correct version of the sentence?
options: The report recommends reducing waste, to improve recycling rates and investing in public transport.
The report recommends to reduce waste, improving recycling rates and to invest in public transport.
The report recommends reduced waste, improved recycling rates and invested in public transport.
The report recommends reducing waste, improving recycling rates and investing in public transport.
explain_zh: recommend 後面列舉三個平行項目時，動詞形式必須一致，全部使用動名詞 reducing、improving、investing 才符合平行結構。選項一混用了不定詞 to improve；選項二三種形式都不一樣，完全破壞平行；選項三誤用過去分詞形式，文法不通。平行結構是雅思寫作 GRA 評分中最容易被扣分的細節之一。

stem: Employees which complete the training programme receive a certificate at the end of the course. Which is the correct version of the sentence?
options: Employees who complete the training programme receive a certificate at the end of the course.
Employees which completes the training programme receive a certificate at the end of the course.
Employees whose complete the training programme receive a certificate at the end of the course.
Employees which complete the training programme receives a certificate at the end of the course.
explain_zh: employees 是人，關係代名詞必須用 who，which 只能指事物。選項二除了關係代名詞用錯，動詞 completes 也與複數先行詞不一致；選項三 whose 是所有格關係代名詞，後面必須接名詞而非動詞；選項四同樣誤用 which，且主要動詞 receives 也與複數主詞不一致。who／which 混淆是雅思寫作常見錯誤。

stem: The report provides an overview about the causes of youth unemployment in rural areas. Which is the correct version of the sentence?
options: The report provides an overview about the causes of youth unemployment in rural areas.
The report provides an overview of the causes of youth unemployment in rural areas.
The report provides overview of the causes of youth unemployment in rural areas.
The report provides an overview for the causes of youth unemployment in rural areas.
explain_zh: overview 的固定搭配介系詞是 of，不是 about 或 for，選項二 an overview of 才是正確搭配。選項一與選項四介系詞都用錯；選項三漏掉了必要的冠詞 an。固定的名詞加介系詞搭配（collocation）是雅思寫作評分中常被忽略的細節。

stem: By the time researchers published their findings, public opinion already shifts on the issue. Which is the correct version of the sentence?
options: By the time researchers published their findings, public opinion already shifts on the issue.
By the time researchers publish their findings, public opinion already shifted on the issue.
By the time researchers published their findings, public opinion had already shifted on the issue.
By the time researchers published their findings, public opinion has already shifted on the issue.
explain_zh: 由於主要子句是過去式 published，表示更早發生的動作要用過去完成式 had already shifted，說明輿論轉向發生在研究結果公布之前。選項一時態不一致，present shifts 與過去語境矛盾；選項二 publish 與 shifted 時態順序顛倒；選項四用現在完成式 has，與整句的過去時間框架不符。過去完成式是雅思寫作描述時間先後順序的重要工具。

stem: Fewer amount of plastic waste was recycled last year compared with the previous twelve months. Which is the correct version of the sentence?
options: Fewer amount of plastic waste was recycled last year compared with the previous twelve months.
Fewer amounts of plastic waste was recycled last year compared with the previous twelve months.
Less amounts of plastic waste was recycled last year compared with the previous twelve months.
Less plastic waste was recycled last year compared with the previous twelve months.
explain_zh: waste 是不可數名詞，須用 less 而非 fewer（fewer 只能修飾可數名詞），且不可數名詞不需要複數形式，動詞用單數 was 才正確。選項一與選項二都誤用 fewer 搭配不可數名詞；選項三雖然改成 less，卻多加了不必要的複數 amounts，仍不通順。less／fewer 的可數與不可數區分是雅思寫作常見錯誤。

stem: The committee is responsible for review all funding applications submitted before the deadline. Which is the correct version of the sentence?
options: The committee is responsible for reviewing all funding applications submitted before the deadline.
The committee is responsible to review all funding applications submitted before the deadline.
The committee is responsible for reviewed all funding applications submitted before the deadline.
The committee is responsible for review all funding applications submitted before the deadline.
explain_zh: be responsible for 的固定搭配後面須接動名詞，故應為 reviewing。選項二誤用介系詞 to 而非 for；選項三誤用過去分詞 reviewed；選項四保留原句錯誤，介系詞後直接接原形動詞 review 不合文法。介系詞後接動名詞是雅思寫作最基本卻也最常被忽略的規則。

stem: The new policy is more effective than the previous one, but it is more expensiver to implement. Which is the correct version of the sentence?
options: The new policy is more effective than the previous one, but it is expensiver to implement.
The new policy is more effective than the previous one, but it is more expensive to implement.
The new policy is more effective than the previous one, but it is most expensive to implement.
The new policy is effectiver than the previous one, but it is more expensive to implement.
explain_zh: expensive 是多音節形容詞，比較級須用 more expensive，不能加 -er，expensiver 不是英文單字。選項一雖拿掉 more 卻仍保留錯誤的 expensiver；選項三誤用最高級 most，但此處只比較兩個政策，應用比較級；選項四把 effective 也誤加 -er 變成 effectiver，同樣是不存在的字。多音節形容詞比較級的規則是雅思寫作常見錯誤。

stem: The report was written by my colleague and I, based on three months of fieldwork in rural schools. Which is the correct version of the sentence?
options: The report was written by my colleague and I, based on three months of fieldwork in rural schools.
The report was written by my colleague and myself, based on three months of fieldwork in rural schools.
The report was written by my colleague and me, based on three months of fieldwork in rural schools.
The report was written by I and my colleague, based on three months of fieldwork in rural schools.
explain_zh: 介系詞 by 後面的代名詞須用受格 me，而非主格 I，所以正確形式是 by my colleague and me。選項一誤用主格 I 當介系詞受詞；選項二誤用反身代名詞 myself，反身代名詞通常需要與句子主詞相同才能使用；選項四把主格 I 放在受詞位置且語序也不自然。介系詞後代名詞格位是雅思寫作常見的細節錯誤。

stem: The government hasn't done nothing to address the housing shortage in the past two years. Which is the correct version of the sentence?
options: The government hasn't done nothing to address the housing shortage in the past two years.
The government haven't done anything to address the housing shortage in the past two years.
The government hasn't did anything to address the housing shortage in the past two years.
The government hasn't done anything to address the housing shortage in the past two years.
explain_zh: government 是單數主詞，助動詞須用 hasn't，且英文不能使用雙重否定，hasn't nothing 應改成 hasn't anything（或 has done nothing）。選項一保留雙重否定的錯誤；選項二助動詞 haven't 與單數主詞不一致；選項三動詞形式錯誤，hasn't 後面應接過去分詞 done 而非過去式 did。雙重否定是雅思寫作明顯的文法扣分點。

stem: If the government had invested more in public transport, congestion levels would not rising so quickly today. Which is the correct version of the sentence?
options: If the government had invested more in public transport, congestion levels would not be rising so quickly today.
If the government had invested more in public transport, congestion levels would not rising so quickly today.
If the government invested more in public transport, congestion levels would not have risen so quickly today.
If the government had invested more in public transport, congestion levels would not risen so quickly today.
explain_zh: 此句是混合條件句：if 子句描述過去未發生的投資（had invested），主要子句描述對現在的持續影響，須用 would not be rising 表示現在正在發生的狀態。選項二漏掉必要的 be，rising 前不能直接接 not；選項三把 if 子句改成現在式，與主要子句描述過去結果的邏輯不符；選項四漏掉助動詞 have，risen 前面缺少必要成分。混合條件句是雅思寫作高階文法的重要考點。

stem: The two reports findings were presented separately, but both reached the same conclusion about student wellbeing. Which is the correct version of the sentence?
options: The two reports findings were presented separately, but both reached the same conclusion about student wellbeing.
The two reports' findings were presented separately, but both reached the same conclusion about student wellbeing.
The two report's findings were presented separately, but both reached the same conclusion about student wellbeing.
The two reports's findings were presented separately, but both reached the same conclusion about student wellbeing.
explain_zh: reports 是複數名詞，字尾已有 s，複數所有格只需在字尾加撇號，寫成 reports'。選項一完全漏掉撇號；選項三用單數所有格 report's，與 two reports 的複數語意矛盾；選項四多加了不必要的 s，寫成 reports's 不合規則。複數名詞所有格的撇號位置是雅思寫作常見的標點錯誤。

stem: The proportion of households recycling their waste increased ____ 42% in 2010 to 68% in 2020.
explain_zh: from X to Y 是描述數據從某個起點變化到終點的固定句型，此處要用 from 搭配後面的 to。by 用於表示變化的幅度（例如 increased by 26 percentage points），與句型不符；to 若單獨使用需搭配前面已出現的 from；at 不是描述變化區間的正確介系詞。from...to 是雅思 Task 1 最基本的數據句型。

stem: Average house prices in the capital increased ____ almost 12% over the course of a single year, according to official statistics.
explain_zh: by 用來表示數值變化的「幅度」，此處 12% 就是漲幅本身，須搭配 by。to 用於表示變化後的最終數值而非漲幅；from 須搭配 to 組成區間句型；at 不是描述漲幅的正確介系詞。分清 increase by（漲幅）與 increase to（結果數值）是雅思 Task 1 的關鍵。

stem: Spending on healthcare rose sharply last year ____ the previous decade, when growth had remained relatively flat.
explain_zh: compared with 是固定片語，用來比較兩個時期或項目的數據。compared of 的介系詞完全不存在這種搭配；comparing to 應該用過去分詞 compared 而非現在分詞，且句中此處不需要動名詞；in comparing 用法不合固定搭配。compared with／to 是雅思 Task 1 對比句型的核心用語。

stem: ____ the proportion of students studying science subjects increased steadily, the number choosing arts subjects declined over the same period.
explain_zh: Whereas 用來連接兩組方向相反的數據（一個上升、一個下降），表達對比關係。Despite 後面須接名詞或動名詞，不能直接接完整子句；Because 表示因果，與此處單純的數據對比語意不符；Since 通常表示原因或時間起點，同樣不符合對比語意。whereas／while 是雅思 Task 1 描述對比趨勢的關鍵連接詞。

stem: Renewable sources now ____ nearly a third of total electricity generation, up from less than a tenth in 2005.
explain_zh: account for 是固定片語，意思是「占…比例」，是雅思 Task 1 描述數據占比的核心動詞片語。account to、account of、accounted at 的介系詞搭配都不存在，皆不合英文固定用法。account for 後面直接接比例或數量，是圓餅圖與比例類題型的必備句型。

stem: In 2020, twice ____ many students enrolled in online courses as had done so five years earlier.
explain_zh: twice as many...as 是固定的倍數比較句型，用來表示「是…的兩倍」。so many...as 不是標準的倍數比較搭配；much 只能修飾不可數名詞，此處 students 是可數名詞；more 會與 twice as 的固定結構衝突，不能替換 as。twice as many/much as 是雅思 Task 1 描述倍數關係的必考句型。

stem: The number of electric vehicles on the road ____ expected to triple by 2030, according to industry forecasts.
explain_zh: the number of 是單數主詞，被動句 is expected to 須用單數動詞 is，且句子描述對未來的預測，用現在式被動最自然。are 與單數主詞不一致；was 是過去式，與描述未來預測的語境不符；be 不能單獨當主要動詞使用。is expected to 是雅思 Task 1 描述未來預測數據的常見句型。

stem: Unemployment fell from 8% to 5% between 2015 and 2020, while average wages rose by 10% ____ the same period.
explain_zh: over the same period 是固定片語，用來指同一段時間內另一組數據的變化。during from 與 for during 都是不存在的介系詞組合；at 不能搭配一段時間（period）使用，通常只用於時間點。over the same period 是雅思 Task 1 比較兩組數據時間範圍的常見句型。

stem: The proportion of graduates ____ found employment within six months has risen steadily since 2018.
explain_zh: graduates 是人，關係代名詞要用 who 且在此處作後面動詞 found 的主詞。which 只能指事物；whom 是受格，用於關係子句中的受詞位置，而此處 who 是子句主詞而非受詞；whose 是所有格關係代名詞，後面須接名詞而非動詞。who 是描述人群類別數據時常用的關係代名詞。

stem: The number of applicants to the programme ____ more than doubled since the university removed the entry examination in 2017.
explain_zh: since + 過去時間點通常搭配現在完成式，has more than doubled 表示「從那時到現在已成長超過一倍」。is 與 was 都不能直接接 more than doubled 這種完成式結構；do 是助動詞但與此處需要的完成式意義不符，且與單數主詞 number 也不一致。has + 過去分詞是雅思 Task 1 搭配 since 描述持續趨勢的必備時態。

stem: Coffee consumption was ____ highest in the 25–34 age group, reaching almost three cups per day on average.
explain_zh: at its highest 是固定片語，用來描述數據達到「最高點」，常見於雅思 Task 1 描述極值。in its、on its、by its 都不是這個固定搭配所使用的介系詞，語法上不成立。at its highest／lowest／peak 是描述圖表最高與最低點的標準句型。

stem: Public transport use increased in the capital, ____ contrast to rural areas, where car dependency remained high.
explain_zh: in contrast to 是固定片語，用來對比兩個地區或項目的數據差異。at contrast to、on contrast to、by contrast to 都不是正確的介系詞搭配，唯有 in contrast to 才是標準用法（另外也可用 by contrast, 但此處介系詞須為 in）。in contrast to 是雅思 Task 1 描述兩地數據差異的常用句型。

stem: Youth unemployment fell steadily after 2015, and a ____ trend can be observed in several neighbouring countries.
explain_zh: similar 是形容詞，直接修飾名詞 trend，且前面有不定冠詞 a，故用 similar。similarly 是副詞，不能直接修飾名詞；same 通常須搭配定冠詞 the same trend，不能接不定冠詞 a；alike 是敘述性形容詞，只能放在名詞之後（例如 the trends are alike），不能放在名詞前面。similar 是雅思 Task 1 比較不同地區相似趨勢的常用字。

stem: In every year shown on the chart, male graduates in engineering ____ outnumbered by their female counterparts in the fields of nursing and education.
explain_zh: 主詞 male graduates 是複數，且圖表描述的是已完成的歷史數據，被動語態須用複數過去式 were。was 與複數主詞不一致；has 缺少必要的 been 才能構成完成式被動，且不符合圖表描述已完成年度數據常用的簡單過去式；is 是現在式，與圖表呈現的歷史年度數據時態不符。were outnumbered by 是雅思 Task 1 描述性別比較數據的常見被動句型。

stem: The birth rate ____ relatively stable at around 1.6 children per woman throughout the entire ten-year period shown in the graph.
explain_zh: 圖表描述的是已經結束的十年期間（throughout the entire ten-year period shown），須用簡單過去式 remained。remains 是現在式，與已完成的歷史時間框架不符；remaining 不是限定動詞，句子會缺少主要動詞；has remain 動詞形式錯誤，完成式須用過去分詞 remained 而非原形 remain。remained stable at 是雅思 Task 1 描述數據持平時的固定句型。

stem: Although it is often argued that social media connects people, it could ____ argued that it increases feelings of isolation.
explain_zh: 空格修飾後面的過去分詞 argued，須用副詞 equally，意思是「同樣地可以主張」，是雅思寫作提出反方論點時的常見銜接詞。equal 是形容詞或動詞；equalize 是動詞（使平等）；equality 是名詞，三者詞性都不能直接修飾動詞 argued。equally 讓正反論點在文法上對稱呈現。

stem: ____ is often young people, rather than older generations, who suffer most from a lack of affordable housing.
explain_zh: It is...who 是強調句型（cleft sentence），用來凸顯句子中被強調的成分（young people），是雅思寫作加強論點的高分句型。There／This／That 都不能與後面的 who 子句組成這種強調句結構。It is...who/that 能讓讀者立刻注意到作者想強調的重點。

stem: Not only ____ social media affect teenagers' sleep patterns, but it also reduces the time they spend on physical activity.
explain_zh: Not only 放在句首會觸發倒裝，主詞 social media 之後要用助動詞 does（因主詞為單數且句意為一般現在式），再接原形動詞 affect。that、it、is 都無法正確完成這個倒裝助動詞的位置。Not only...but also 的倒裝句型是雅思寫作展現高階句構的重要技巧。

stem: ____ is no denying that climate change poses a serious threat to coastal communities around the world.
explain_zh: There is no denying that 是固定的論證句型，意思是「不可否認的是」，用來引出作者高度確信的論點。It／This／That is no denying that 都不符合這個固定用法的文法結構。There is no denying that 是雅思寫作 Task 2 開頭陳述強烈共識論點的常見句型。

stem: Critics of the policy ____ that it unfairly penalises low-income families who cannot afford to switch to electric vehicles.
explain_zh: 主詞 Critics 是複數，動詞須用原形 argue 以符合主詞動詞一致。argues 是第三人稱單數形式，與複數主詞不符；arguing 不是限定動詞，句子會缺少主要動詞；to argue 是不定詞，同樣不能單獨作句子的主要動詞。critics argue that 是雅思寫作引述反對意見時的常見句型。

stem: Proponents of nuclear energy ____ that it offers a reliable, low-carbon alternative to fossil fuels.
explain_zh: 主詞 Proponents 是複數，動詞須用原形 claim。claims 是第三人稱單數形式，與複數主詞不符；claiming 不是限定動詞；to claim 是不定詞，不能單獨作句子主要動詞。proponents claim that 是雅思寫作引述支持意見時的常見句型。

stem: The scheme was originally intended to reduce congestion, but it ____ instead created new problems for local residents.
explain_zh: has instead created 用現在完成式，表示這個計畫從過去到現在持續造成新問題，強調對現況的影響，語意上與前半句的過去意圖形成對比。is 現在式與句子描述已發生的後果語境不符；was 過去簡單式無法強調「持續至今」的結果；having 不是限定動詞。has 搭配過去分詞是雅思寫作論證段落表達持續性後果的常見時態。

stem: The ____ people rely on cars for short journeys, the more congested city centres are likely to become.
explain_zh: the more...the more 是固定的相關比較句型，用來表達兩件事情程度上同步增減的因果關係。most 是最高級，不能用於這種雙重比較結構；much 與 many 是一般程度／數量詞，不能放在 the 之後組成這個固定句型。the more...the more 是雅思寫作論證因果連動關係的高分句型。

stem: The consequences of inaction are ____ serious that governments can no longer afford to delay reform of the pension system.
explain_zh: so + 形容詞 + that 是固定句型，此處 serious 是形容詞，須用 so。such 後面須直接接名詞（such serious consequences that）而非單獨接形容詞；too 不與 that 子句連用；very 不能接 that 子句。so...that 是雅思寫作論證段落強調後果嚴重性的常見句型。

stem: ____ for strict environmental regulations, many rivers in industrial regions would still be heavily polluted today.
explain_zh: Were it not for 是虛擬語氣倒裝結構，表示「若不是因為…」，後面接 would still be，呈現與現實相反的假設。Unless 語意是「除非」，與此處已知現實（法規確實存在）矛盾；If not for 文法不完整，須是 if it were not for；Without being for 不是英文的固定搭配。Were it not for 是雅思寫作展現高階虛擬語氣的重要句型。

stem: Automation has undoubtedly reduced the number of factory jobs; ____ is not to say that technology has caused overall unemployment.
explain_zh: this is not to say that 是固定的論證限縮句型，用來補充說明前面的陳述不代表另一個更廣泛的結論，this 承接前面整句話的概念。it 通常需要明確的單一名詞先行詞；which 不能在分號後單獨開啟新的獨立子句；what 不是這個固定片語的用法。this is not to say that 是雅思寫作避免論點被過度推論的高分句型。

stem: ____ from being a solution to traffic congestion, new ring roads often encourage more people to drive into cities.
explain_zh: far from being 是固定片語，意思是「遠非…；絕非…」，用來否定前面的預期，引出與預期相反的論點。Away from being、Apart from being 語意搭配不符（apart from 通常表示「除了…之外」而非否定）；Besides 通常表示「此外」，不能與 from being 這樣搭配。far from being 是雅思寫作反駁常見迷思時的高分開場句型。

stem: It could ____ that standardised testing, while efficient, fails to measure creativity or critical thinking.
explain_zh: could be argued that 是「情態助動詞 + 被動原形」的固定限制語句型。argues 是限定動詞形式，不能接在情態助動詞 could 後面（could 後面須接原形動詞）；arguing 是分詞，同樣不能直接接在 could 後面；argument 是名詞。be argued 讓論點以被動、客觀的方式呈現，是雅思寫作常見的論證句型。

stem: One argument in ____ of stricter advertising laws is that they help protect children from harmful marketing messages.
explain_zh: in favour of 是固定片語，意思是「支持…」，是雅思寫作 Task 2 列舉支持論點時的常用句型。favour with、favour to 的介系詞搭配都不存在；favours 是複數名詞形式，但固定片語中 favour 須維持單數不可數用法。in favour of／against 是描述立場的核心句型。

stem: Genetic modification of crops could help address food shortages, ____ that strict safety testing is carried out beforehand.
explain_zh: provided that 意思是「只要；前提是」，用來附加一個必要條件，是雅思寫作論證段落表達有條件支持時的常見句型。despite 後面須接名詞或動名詞，不能接完整子句；unless 語意是「除非」，會把整句邏輯變成相反意思；although 表示讓步轉折，與此處條件語意不符。provided that 讓論點顯得有保留、更具說服力。
